sourceDesign.exportCommand: Pencil MCP Export, six individual PNG crops, scale 1

intentionalDifferences: Keep the ranking filter, UTC times, true context fields, explicit mark-read action, and Today/Earlier order. Mock rows cannot replace real feed data.
Settings retain the account master switch, all five existing categories and explicit persistence. No test-push action, new category or implicit permission prompt.

The cAqsQ unread count is plain muted text. The existing U3 summary chip is retained as a small contrast-positive adaptation; its green-ink on green-soft pair matches the positive glyph palette in cAqsQ and qNVpA.
Navigation chrome owns the top bars. Locale and theme remain in Me instead of overlapping the notification settings action.
Update banner borrows the shared card and button treatment; tzBrY is an install/failure board, not a dedicated update frame.

baselineReview.notifications-center-populated.png: Replaces the legacy inset panel and green-wash rows with standalone filters, grouped hairline rows and an unread dot.
baselineReview.notifications-center-populated-dark.png: Same intentional layout changes; dark semantic palette and unread distinction pinned independently.
baselineReview.notifications-center-empty.png: Empty state follows the Clubhouse back/settings bar and filter/summary sequence instead of the old title block and segmented toolbar.
baselineReview.notifications-preferences.png: Previous baseline drift: 34,896 pixels (about 10.6%). Setup precedes switches; visible helper text, switch tracks and card rhythm change layout.
baselineReview.notifications-center-populated-desktop.p: Same grouped-list structure as mobile at the unchanged 480px content cap. Timestamp text masked.
baselineReview.notifications-center-empty-desktop.png: Same back/settings bar and empty-state rhythm as mobile, retaining the existing content cap.
baselineReview.notifications-preferences-desktop.png: Previous baseline drift: 37,319 pixels (about 3.6%). Switch hierarchy and setup-first order change the rendered composition.
baselineReview.push-preferences.spec.ts: Four card crops changed by 4,933–7,610 pixels across viewport and state. New glyph, sentence-case hierarchy, mobile gutters and larger retry button explain the change; the existing 3% per-card budget stays.

visualBudgets.kind: Playwright browser baselines, not literal Pencil image equality
visualBudgets.rationale: Existing per-screen budgets unchanged; cross-platform text rasterization only. Exact probes guard layout, palette, semantics and controls. UTC timestamps masked when present.

detailFrames: D1 implemented (2026-11-20): the generic, match result and level review outcome detail layouts are pinned in e2e/references/paf-202-d1-notifications/manifest.json. The community invitation branch keeps its U8 frames and is unchanged.
